research_question: Does KMFC sparsity persist necessarily under the fixed projectile/target, or does approach support and source-axis convention materially alter reachability?

held_fixed: deterministic case-specific aleatory and epistemic seeds
controlled_factors.important_semantics: Every accepted trajectory points toward the target and body +X is aligned with velocity. Therefore -body-X is outward and +body-X is inward at first contact.

direction_pose_only.interpretation: The source axis, target, profiles, speed and tree are unchanged. Only the inward cardinal approach direction, aligned pose and compatible transverse grid vary.

source_axis_only.interpretation: Each pair has identical approach face, contact-ray origin, velocity, pose, profile, speed and seeds. Only Taylor direction.axis_body changes from [-1,0,0] to [+1,0,0].
source_axis_only.scientific_guard: This diagnoses sensitivity to a coordinate/sign convention. It is not evidence that +body-X is the physically correct Taylor axis.

interpretation_guards.axis_flip_status: Sensitivity intervention only; it does not establish that +body-X is physically correct.
interpretation_guards.tree_gate_fact: The zero-anchored smooth score is exactly zero whenever every underlying component energy is zero. Threshold changes alter magnitude but cannot create support.
interpretation_guards.sampling_boundary: The deterministic cardinal grid is an intervention design, not an operational reference distribution and not a balanced training distribution.
interpretation_guards.validation_boundary: All physics models and munition parameters remain unverified; results identify software-mechanism sensitivity, not real-world lethality.
